name: Cloudflare SDK Key
description: Optional submodule of Cloudflare SDK: resolve a credential set's Cloudflare API token from the Key module instead of settings.php.
project_description: Optional integration between the Cloudflare module suite and Drupal's Key module. By default a Cloudflare credential set reads its account ID and API token from settings.php; enable this submodule to instead resolve the token from a Key (an environment variable, a file outside the webroot, or any other Key provider) while keeping it out of exported configuration. It decorates the credential resolver: a credential set opts in by naming an authentication Key on the credentials form and entering the (non-secret) account ID; sets that name no Key fall through to the settings.php behaviour unchanged.
